review_notes: I read the whole 66-line file and grepped for uses of appendEncodeTapes, entryAppendRestoreTM and entryAppendRestoreTime across the RegisterStore directory. The only simp lemmas are the two projection lemmas for appendEncodeTapes (address and value). Both are rfl lemmas that rewrite the projection of the non-reducible def to its definition. That is the canonical direction, and neither can loop. The `ne` field is a proof, so it needs no simp lemma. The other two declarations are a machine and a time bound. Downstream files unfold them explicitly (`unfold entryAppendRestoreTM`, `unfold ... entryAppendRestoreTime`) and nothing suggests they should be simp-expanded. I did not inspect the EntryEncodeTapes and EntryReplaceTapes definitions or the uses in the Internal files in depth, so a subtle competing-rule issue there remains possible. I found no justified simp-interface problem.
